finalJustifications: Because the NACLs are the firewall at the level of SUB-REDE: Statess, entry/exit rules evaluated in numerical order, applied before traffic reaches the instances.

Because the NACLs replace the Security Groups when configured, unifying the subnet firewall at a single control point.

finalJustifications: Because Redshift is the managed data warehouse of AWS: columnar storage and massively parallel processing, optimized for analytical queries in large volumes.
Because Redshift is a memory columnar cache that accelerates any connected relational database without migration of cluster data.
Because Redshift replaces the S3 as a layer of raw lake storage, unifying ingestion and analysis in a single managed service.
Because Redshift executes the transactional and analytical loads together, eliminating the separation between OLTP and OLAP on the BI platform.
